summary: An OpenAI employee states that OpenAI temporarily slowed some frontier training and put its largest planned frontier RL run on hold to strengthen security/monitoring and gather more evidence of alignment.

mechanisms.reason: The lab's largest planned frontier RL run is paused pending safeguards, temporarily reducing training compute demand.
mechanisms.quote: Our largest planned frontier RL run remains on hold while smaller-scale training and evaluations help us test safeguards and gather more evidence of alignment.

practices.reason: The post describes internal safety evaluation and safeguard-testing work during smaller-scale training, but gives no transferable method.
practices.quote: smaller-scale training and evaluations help us test safeguards and gather more evidence of alignment

notable_reason: A frontier lab disclosing that it has paused its largest planned frontier RL training run for safety/security reasons is an unusual and consequential disclosure for compute-demand watchers.
